The correct answer is 1906.

Key Points

  • The Muslim League was established on December 30, 1906, at Dacca, under the direction of Aga Khan, the Nawab of Dhaka, and Nawab Mohsin-ul-Mulk.
  • When British India was divided in 1947, a political party was the driving force behind the movement asking for the creation of a separate Muslim nation out of concern that Hindus would take over an independent India.
  • It was established to protect Indian Muslims' rights.
  • In 1913, Muhammad Ali Jinnah joined the league.
  • The league was terminated on August 14th, 1947. In Pakistan, Bangladesh, and India, it is still present in political parties under different guises.

Additional Information The objectives of the league were:

  • To protect Muslims' political rights and to express such rights to the government.
  • To combat the animosity Muslims have towards other communities.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate alternative to replace the underlined segment in the given sentence. They met yesterday, haven’t they ?

They met yesterday, haven’t they?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is didn’t they?Key Points

  • The sentence “They met yesterday” is in the simple past tense.

questions.question: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence. She has learned many lessons in this camp.

  • The object should be converted into subject and the subject into an object.
  • A “be” verb should be added according to the tense and subject.
  • As the sentence here is in Present Perfect tense, in the passive voice "been" should be used.
  • The subject, “She”  will be “her” as the object, and a “by” will be added before it.

  • Option 2 is incorrect as the sentence is in the present continuous tense.
